python3 -c '
import urllib.request, bz2, eccodes, numpy as np

ODESSA_LAT, ODESSA_LON = 46.4406, 30.7703
run = "2026092300"
lead = "007"
levels = [55,58,60,62,64,66,68,70,72,74]
base = "https://opendata.dwd.de/weather/nwp/icon-eu/grib/00/p/icon-eu_europe_regular-lat-lon_model-level_{}_{}_{}_P.grib2.bz2"

results = []
for lvl in levels:
    u = base.format(run, lead, lvl)
    try:
        raw = urllib.request.urlopen(u, timeout=30).read()
        data = bz2.decompress(raw)
        path = f"/tmp/p_{lvl}.grib2"
        open(path,"wb").write(data)
        f = open(path,"rb")
        gid = eccodes.codes_grib_new_from_file(f)
        rd = eccodes.codes_grib_get_data(gid)
        lats = np.array([d.lat for d in rd]); lons = np.array([d.lon for d in rd]); vals = np.array([d.value for d in rd])
        idx = np.argmin((lats-ODESSA_LAT)**2 + (lons-ODESSA_LON)**2)
        p_hpa = vals[idx]/100.0
        results.append((lvl, len(raw), round(p_hpa,2)))
        eccodes.codes_release(gid)
        f.close()
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((lvl, None, f"ERR {e}"))

for r in results:
    print(r)
'
